newsitem.title: USA: Spatialight names Loomis as COO.
newsitem.headline: Spatialight names Loomis as COO.

text.p: Spatialight Inc said Wednesday it has appointed L. John Loomis to the new position of chief operating officer.

Loomis joins the company from Compaq Computer Corp where he served as director of creative and software development for the Presario personal computer. Prior to Compaq, Loomis was president and chief operating officer for Motion Works Corp.
Spatialight owns, designs, develops and makes high-content information display system components for the monitor/projection/computing and display industry in general.
